items.title: Hyperscalers Face “$1.5 Trillion Gap” Between AI Spending and Cash
items.summary: Key TakeawaysHyperscaler free cash flow turned negative in the third quarter for the first time, and Microsoft is the only one of Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta Platforms and Oracle with positive free cash flow. Prof G Markets co-host Ed Elson expects the five companies to spend more than $2 trillion on capex over the next two years, against nearly $600 billion of cash on hand.
